description:
Low-level escape hatch: create a media container with arbitrary parameters, without publishing it.

Prefer instagram_publish_image / _reel / _story / _carousel, which run the whole flow. Use this when you need a parameter those tools do not expose, or when assembling a carousel from children that were created earlier.

Returns the container ID. Publish it with instagram_publish_container.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

caption.description: Caption text, up to 2200 characters. Hashtags and @mentions work inside the caption. Instagram counts a maximum of 30 hashtags.

extra_params.description: Any other documented container parameter, passed through verbatim (e.g. cover_url, thumb_offset, share_to_feed, alt_text, product_tags, upload_type).

is_carousel_item.description: True when this container is a carousel child

media_type.description: Omit for a single image; Instagram infers IMAGE

name: instagram_create_container
title: Create Media Container
